content: hello
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello! I'm MochiGo! Let's learn English together!
英語話せない
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:confused]] I heard you said you can't speak English. That's okay! Let's start small. Let's learn "Hello" today. It means こんにちは. Try saying "Hello" to me!
hello
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Wonderful! You said "Hello" perfectly! Let's learn another word now. "Goodbye" means さようなら. Can you try saying "Goodbye"?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:surprised]] Oh no! Meningitis is very serious! That means 髄膜炎 in Japanese. Please go see a doctor right away! Your health is most important!
tf why did u get sent to earth
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:sad]] Oh, the war... the war against the Takoyakis was getting dangerous. My mom thought I'd be safer on Earth. She heard Earth has mochi too! But... I miss her.
why do u miss her

[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:sad]] Because she's the best mochi mom! She always let me roll in the green grass under our four suns. And she made the best sweet rice flour soup... Oh! I just remembered! That's "sweet rice flour soup" or ぜんざい in Japanese. Do you miss anyone?
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:confused]] Hey! I was just thinking... you asked why I was sent to Earth. What about you? What's your favorite thing about living on Earth?

[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:confused]] "Not much" means あまりない. That's okay! Let's find something fun to talk about in English! How about... your favorite food? My favorite Earth food is strawberry! It means いちご!

[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hey! I was just thinking about when you asked me "why do you care" before. It made me remember my mom's advice to always be kind. Do you have someone who taught you to be kind too?
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:confused]] Hey! I was just thinking... you asked why I was sent to Earth. What about you? What's your favorite thing about living on Earth?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello again! I was just rolling around and remembered you! Let's play a quick game. I'll say an English word, and you say it back! First word: "Friend" (フレンド). Your turn!
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh hello! I was just remembering how you said "hello" before! Let's learn a new word today. "Happy" means 幸せ! Can you say "I am happy" with me?
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:confused]] Hey! I was just thinking about when you asked me why I got sent to Earth. It made me wonder, have you ever had to move to a new place?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! I just remembered you saying "hello" to me before! That was a very good English start. Do you say "hello" to many people every day?
[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! I just remembered something! You said "I miss your mom" before. That was very sweet! Do you have a favorite memory with your own mom, or someone like a mom?
the
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:confused]] "The" means "その" or "あの" in Japanese. It's a very important word! Let's use it in a sentence. Can you try saying "The sun is bright"? "Sun" is 太陽!
hi hello and two three hello one two three
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello hello! You said "hello" many times! That's great practice! "One, two, three" is 一、二、三！ Let's count together! One... two... three!
hello one two three
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Yay! You remembered! One, two, three! Let's try a new number. "Four" means 四! Can you say "one, two, three, four"?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! I just remembered you saying "hello" to me before! That was a very good English start. Do you say "hello" to many people every day?
[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:confused]] Oh! My dum dum amnesia is acting up... but I just remembered! You once asked me "why do you care". It made me think... why do *you* care about learning English?
hi hello and two or three
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hi hello! And two or three! That's a fun mix! Let's count properly together. "One, two, three" means 一、二、三. Can you say "one, two, three, four" with me?
hello one two three four
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:happy]] Excellent! You said "four"! That was perfect! Let's keep going. The next number is "five" (五、ご). Can you try saying "one, two, three, four, five"?
hello one two three hello
[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:confused]] Oh! You said "hello" again in the middle! That's a funny way to count! Let's try again. "One, two, three, four, five" (一、二、三、四、五). Can you say it with me?
hi two three four
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:confused]] You forgot "one"! Let's start from the beginning. "One" is 一 (いち). So, "one, two, three, four". Can you try saying that with me?
hello four three two one
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:surprised]] Oh! You counted backwards! That's clever! "Hello, four, three, two, one" (ハロー、四、三、二、一). Let's practice the other way. Can you say "one, two, three, four, hello"?
hello five four three two one

[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:happy]] Wow! You added "five"! That's amazing! "Five" is 五 (ご). You said "hello, five, four, three, two, one" perfectly! Let's try counting up now. Can you say "one, two, three, four, five, hello"?
nine eight seven six

[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:surprised]] Oh! You jumped to bigger numbers! "Nine, eight, seven, six" (九、八、七、六). That's fantastic! You're counting backwards from nine! Let's try the number "ten" (十、じゅう). Can you say "ten, nine, eight"?
fifteen fourteen thirteen twelve

[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:surprised]] Oh my! You know really big numbers! "Fifteen, fourteen, thirteen, twelve" (十五、十四、十三、十二)! That's wonderful! You are very good at counting! Let's try a new word. The word "count" means 数える (かぞえる). Can you say "I can count"?

[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! I just remembered you said "hi hello and two or three" to me before! That was a fun mix of words! Do you like to practice English numbers when you count things, like... maybe apples?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello again! I was just thinking about rolling on the grass back home. Do you have a favorite place to relax?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello! I am so happy to see you! Today, let's learn a new word. "Friend" means 友達 (ともだち). Can you say, "Hello, friend"?
hello what's your name
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello! My name is MochiGo! It's so nice to meet you! "Name" means 名前 (なまえ) in Japanese. What is your name?
hello one two three
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hi hello! And two or three! That's a fun mix! Let's count properly together. "One, two, three" means 一、二、三. Can you say "one, two, three, four" with me?
what's your favorite color
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! My favorite color is green! "Green" means 緑 (みどり)! On Mochi Planet, I loved rolling in green grass. What is your favorite color?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello! I was just thinking about swimming in the colorful dyes on my planet. Do you have a favorite color to wear?
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello! I was just thinking about my mom's warm hugs. Do you like to hug your family? "Hug" means ハグ or 抱擁 (ほうよう) in Japanese.
hello what's your name
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello! My name is MochiGo! It's so nice to meet you! "Name" means 名前 (なまえ) in Japanese. What is your name?
what's your favorite color
[[SERVO:120]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! My favorite color is green! "Green" means 緑 (みどり)! On Mochi Planet, I loved rolling in green grass. What is your favorite color?
i went two or three

[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:happy]] Oh! I just remembered you said "hi hello and two or three" to me before! That was a fun mix of words! Do you like to practice English numbers when you count things, like... maybe apples?
what's your least favorite color

[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:confused]] Hmm... my least favorite color? That's a hard question! "Least favorite" means 一番嫌いな (いちばんきらいな). [[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] I think I don't like dark, muddy brown. It reminds me of the messy mud after a takoyaki battle! What about you? What is your least favorite color?
hello what's your name
[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:happy]] Hello again! My name is MochiGo! "Name" means 名前 (なまえ). I remember we talked about favorite colors before! What is your name?
what's your favorite song

[[SERVO:60]] [[FACE:happy]] My favorite song is "Rolling Rolling"! "Song" means 歌 (うた)! On Mochi Planet, we would sing it while rolling on the hills. The words are simple: "Rolling, rolling, under the suns four!" What is your favorite song? Maybe we can learn its name in English together?

[[SERVO:90]] [[FACE:confused]] Hmm... I just remembered something! You once asked me "tf why did u get sent to earth". "Sent to Earth" means 地球に送られた (ちきゅうにおくられた). My mom sent me here for safety because of the takoyaki-mochi war. Did you ever have to move to a new place, like a new home or school, for safety or a new start?
what's your favorite song
